focusNote: Dec 2026 – Mar 2027 · Pre-enrollment preparation before starting my Master's at Kyoto University NLP Lab. Prioritizing from-scratch PyTorch/LLM implementations, interview-ready English algorithm notes, and daily spoken Japanese.

sections.title: Pre-Enrollment Foundation
sections.note: Arrive in Kyoto ready to read modern LLM/speech papers fluently, run clean PyTorch experiments, and communicate naturally in English and Japanese.

items.text: Launch English personal website with Writing, rich Timeline, and live-editable Plan
items.detail: Built with Astro + KaTeX and deployed to feuclain.github.io.

items.text: Implement core Transformer & LLM modules from scratch in PyTorch
items.detail: Causal MHA, GQA, RoPE, KV cache, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, LoRA, and mini-GPT training loop.

items.text: Run an end-to-end post-training & inference experiment on a small open model
items.detail: Practice SFT + DPO/GRPO workflow, evaluation harnesses, and INT4/AWQ serving.

items.text: Read recent ACL / EMNLP / speech papers from Kyoto University NLP Lab
items.detail: Survey research directions across sub-groups ahead of April advisor matching.

items.text: Complete NeetCode core patterns with English Think-Aloud notes
items.detail: Focus on clean problem decomposition, invariants, edge cases, and complexity explanation.

items.text: Daily Japanese shadowing & spoken technical self-introduction drills
items.detail: 30 min/day listening & shadowing + weekly conversation sessions.

sections.title: Lab Research & Summer Internships
sections.note: Settle into Kyoto NLP Lab, choose a focused research direction, and enter M1 internship pipelines.

items.text: Finalize research advisor & initial Master's research topic
items.detail: Explore intersections of LLM post-training, speech/multimodal processing, and efficient systems.

items.text: Apply for M1 summer & autumn engineering / AI internships in Japan
items.detail: Target global tech teams, semiconductor AI groups, and industrial R&D labs.
Consolidate formal Japanese credential alongside practical lab & interview fluency.

items.text: Aim for first international conference submission (ACL / EMNLP / Interspeech)
items.detail: Release clean, reproducible experiment code alongside the paper.
